instruction: Pick up the blue block with the left arm, hand it over to the right arm in the air, and let the right arm put it in the green square; then both arms let go.

outcome.real_measurement: Block centre inside the right target square at every judged step: min(half - |dx|, half - |dy|) >= 0. Real world: top camera, block centre vs the marked square.
Resting on the table: lowest block point within 5 mm of the table top at every judged step. Real world: RGB-D pose vs the table plane.
Settled: block speed <= 2 cm/s at every judged step. Real world: frame differencing of the tracked pose.
Stays put: block centre moves <= 2 mm over the judged window. Real world: tracked pose, 1 s.

The handover happened in the air: at some point the block was carried by the left arm alone (airborne: no table contact, bottom > 3 mm above the table; only the left robot in contact) for >= 5 control steps (0.25 s), later by the right arm alone for >= 5 steps, and it did not touch the table in between. Derived from per-step contact signals by imsim.verify.handover.handover_signal. Real world: wrist F/T or gripper current per arm + side camera for table contact.

Consequence test after the judged window (protocol v3.1): every arm whose gripper is within 3 cm of the block retracts its TCP 3 cm along its approach axis in 0.5 s, last gripper command unchanged, holds 0.5 s; the block centre must move <= 1 cm. Real world: same motion, tracked block pose.

counterexamples.name: handover
counterexamples.description: positive control: left picks, mid-air handover, right places, both open and retreat

counterexamples.name: no_handover
counterexamples.description: the right arm reaches over and picks the block from the left zone itself, places it in the target, opens and retreats; the left arm never moves

counterexamples.name: both_hold
counterexamples.description: handover grasp by the right arm while the left keeps holding; both arms carry the block into the target and set it down, neither opens

counterexamples.name: drop_and_push
counterexamples.description: the left arm lifts the block and drops it near the centre; the right arm pushes it along the table into the target, both grippers open at the end

source.protocol: v3 (veritask/adapters/protocol_v3.py, unchanged) + imsim v3.1 additions (imsim/imsim/verify/v31.py): all-link enclosure, retreat aftermath; derived handover signal imsim/imsim/verify/handover.py
source.frozen: E23, 2026-11-15, written and hashed before any DualHandover-v1 episode was run; end-state, release, settle and aftermath constants copied from dual_cube_place_v3.1 without tuning; carry_steps / airborne_dz_m chosen a priori

notes: End-state terms 1-4, release rule, settle (hold A) and the retreat aftermath are those of dual_cube_place_v3.1 applied to the block. robot_obj_impulse_Ns = substep-accumulated contact impulse between the block and every collision link of both robots; obj_enclosure_all_m = v3.1 all-link enclosure. The process term handover_done is derived from armL_obj_impulse_Ns, armR_obj_impulse_Ns, table_obj_impulse_Ns and obj_bottom_dz_m (see the term's real_measurement and imsim.verify.handover). The benchmark-style flag (env info['success'], RoboTwin handover_block style) only checks block in target + both grippers open.
